stories.title: More than 1,150 children take part in triathlon day at Mold Leisure Centre with Alistair Brownlee
stories.summary: More than 1,150 children from schools across North Wales took part in a triathlon event at Gwella’s Mold Leisure Centre on Tuesday, with Olympic champion Alistair Brownlee attending to meet pupils and present finisher medals. stories.title: Wales survey: one in two ten and eleven year olds on social media each week

stories.title: Welsh Government consults on leaseholder protections under new building safety law
stories.summary: The Welsh Government is consulting on how to put into practice new laws designed to stop leaseholders in Wales being billed for building safety failures they did not cause. stories.title: New Welsh Government announces £145 million for NHS Wales waiting times
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has announced £145 million in extra funding for NHS Wales this financial year, with waiting times named as the immediate target.
